en.headline: Two men arrested after fight over money in Ma On Shan car park
en.dek: A 42-year-old and a 36-year-old were detained early Tuesday after a dispute in a car park on Kam Ying Road; both were taken to hospital with minor injuries.
body: Police arrested two men on suspicion of fighting in a public place after a dispute in a Ma On Shan car park in the early hours of Tuesday.

Officers received a report from security staff at about 3.40am that two men were fighting in a car park at 6 Kam Ying Road. Initial inquiries suggest the men, aged 42 and 36, had argued over money and then struck each other.
The older man sustained a head injury and the younger man reported neck pain. Both were conscious and taken to Prince of Wales Hospital for treatment. They remain in custody for further inquiries.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山停車場兩男因錢財問題互毆 涉公眾地方打鬥被捕
zh.dek: 今早約3時40分，錦英路6號停車場兩名男子因金錢問題爭執互毆，分別頭部及頸部受傷送院，警方以涉嫌公眾地方打鬥拘捕。
body: 馬鞍山今早發生打鬥事件，兩名男子被警方以涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥拘捕。
警方今早約3時40分接獲保安報案，指錦英路6號一個停車場有兩名男子打架。初步調查相信兩人因金錢問題爭執，其後互相以手襲擊對方。
事件中，42歲姓黃男子頭部受傷，36歲姓鐘男子頸部痛痛。兩人清醒被送往威爾斯親王醫院治理，現正被扣留調查。
